body:
Founder real-time: build DEADWEIGHT in the browser using PARENA. card_rules.prn now emits to web/src/generated/CardRules.ts (third real target alongside C/Java). Hand-written TS client speaks the real wire protocol over a dumb WS<->TCP bridge to the real dw_server. Verified end-to-end: real 11-round match played through the compiled client against a live bot (web/bridge/e2e_test.mjs). Random queue only, no auth, no animation yet -- see web/README.md. Commit 6410616.

⚓ ☃
title: Real browser client (web/) dogfooding PARENA's TypeScript emitter
